title: Carbery's inequality in the Schatten--von Neumann classes
summary: Carbery posed a question of sharpened triangle inequalities for families of operators in the Schatten--von Neumann classes $S_p$, $p\geq 2$. He established a weaker form of the desired estimate for even integer values of $p$. In the commutative setting the corresponding sharp inequality (with optimal exponent $p'=\frac{p}{p-1}$) was recently obtained for all integer $p\geq 2$.
